name: de.i6eal/open-ai-data
title: i6eal Open AI Data MCP Server
description: Read-only MCP server for 16 German & EU open AI datasets (procurement, budgets, DSA, enforcement).

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List all catalogued i6eal Open AI Data datasets covering Germany and the EU, with bilingual titles, descriptions, operating states, observation start dates, distributions, upstream sources, and compilation-only rights scope. Optionally filter by keyword or operating state.

query.description: Optional case- and diacritic-insensitive keyword filter matching dataset ID, title, description, or upstream source names.

state.description: Optional filter by operating model (automated collection, derived projection, reviewed baseline, or collector paused). Operating model is not a live uptime signal.

tools.name: get_dataset_overview
tools.description: Fetch live summary metadata, counts, temporal coverage, data state, upstream sources, available JSON/CSV/Atom distributions, and attribution guidance for one catalogued dataset without dumping large raw record arrays.

tools.name: get_dataset_methodology
tools.description: Fetch the official methodology.json document for a dataset, detailing collection rules, exact-identifier linkage rules, official sources, known exclusions, and what the dataset explicitly does not claim.

tools.name: query_dataset_records
tools.description: Search, filter, and paginate records from any catalogued dataset’s primary JSON record list or one of its sibling CSV distributions. Always returns bounded results with total counts, data state, attribution, and compilation-only rights notice.

query.description: Optional case- and diacritic-insensitive keyword filter (all whitespace-separated terms must match a record).

distribution_path.description: Optional sibling distribution path declared by the dataset (e.g. "/data/ki-haushaltsmonitor/series.csv"). Defaults to the dataset’s primary JSON index.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching records to return (1–100, default 20).

tools.name: get_dataset_changes
tools.description: Fetch and parse the RFC 4287 Atom change feed for a dataset that tracks revisions over time, returning structured recent revision entries with timestamps, summaries, and links.

dataset_id.description: Canonical i6eal dataset identifier for a dataset that publishes an Atom change feed.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent feed entries to return (1–50, default 20).

tools.name: get_dcat_catalogue
tools.description: Fetch the live machine-readable DCAT-AP JSON-LD catalogue (/data/catalog/dcat.jsonld). Optionally filter to a single dataset node to inspect its full RDF distributions, temporal intervals, and rights metadata.

dataset_id.description: Optional dataset identifier to return only that dataset’s DCAT node instead of the catalogue overview.

tools.name: get_platform_automation_dossier
tools.description: Query the EU Platform Automation Monitor (derived from European Commission DSA Transparency Database monthly statements of reasons). Look up a specific online platform by name or slug, or list top platforms with automated detection vs. automated decision breakdowns. Preserves DSA boundaries: statements of reasons are not unique affected users/items, and reported automation does not prove AI use.

platform.description: Optional platform name or slug filter (e.g. "Google Shopping", "TikTok", "YouTube", "Amazon", "google-shopping-496bc298"). Omit to list top platforms by total statements of reasons.

limit.description: Maximum number of platforms to return (1–50, default 10).

sort_by.description: Sort order when listing platforms: "total" (descending statements of reasons) or "name" (alphabetical).

include_timeline.description: Include full monthly timeline arrays when a single platform is matched (default false to keep responses compact).

tools.name: get_enforcement_actions
tools.description: Filter verified official AI-related enforcement actions in Germany and the EU from the AI Enforcement Monitor, returning procedural status, authority, subject, legal basis, recorded amounts (distinguishing fines from other monetary measures), and primary-source evidence links.

query.description: Optional keyword filter matching title, summary, authority, subject, legal basis, or official evidence.

tools.name: get_german_state_ai_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve one or all 16 German federal states (Bundesländer) from German State AI Evidence Layers, keeping its three evidence layers (public AI systems, procurement notices, telecommunications infrastructure) explicitly separate with independent observation timestamps and no composite ranking.

state.description: Optional filter by Bundesland name, slug, ISO 3166-2 code (e.g. "DE-BY", "Bayern", "bavaria", "berlin"), or 2-digit BKG code. Omit to return all 16 states.

tools.name: search_across_datasets
tools.description: Search for an official identifier (such as ECLI, TED notice ID, EUCT number, or budget title number) or keyword across catalogued datasets, returning bounded matches grouped by dataset with source citations. Co-occurring text matches across datasets are never inferred links.

query.description: Official identifier or search terms (at least 2 characters).

dataset_ids.description: Optional subset of dataset identifiers to search. Defaults to all 16 catalogued datasets.

max_per_dataset.description: Maximum sample matches returned per dataset (1–10, default 3).
